lines.text: Jehu's second letter demanded the heads of Ahab's sons at Samaria, and Jehu ordered them piled at the gate.
Jehu said the LORD acted through His servant Isaiah, and he killed everyone left of Ahab's house in Jezreel.
Jehu took Jehonadab into his chariot to see his zeal for the LORD, then struck down Ahab's remaining people in Samaria.
